items.html: And behold, among all of them there are 86 days, in which the three fillings AB, SAG, MA entered. And the drop of the male, which is AB, has already been completed in its forming, and then the fetus becomes fully recognizable. And although these are not fully three months, there is no concern, for what the Gemara says of three months is not exact to the letter. And in particular, if you count the deficient months, they will be 87 days, which are the 86 aforementioned together with the inclusive count.
